synthetic_benchmark.scope: Offline synthetic serialization benchmarks; no selected source correction or financial decision.
synthetic_benchmark.run_order: Each comparison runs old then new; the order is not reversed.
synthetic_benchmark.cpu_basis: The scripts use time.process_time(), so recorded CPU is process CPU, not thread CPU.

kv_set_kv_4096.recorded_scope: Exact-native finite validation and direct dump only when valid; unchanged original fallback otherwise.

naive_deep_error_counterexample.tested_python: 3.12 as recorded in the saved benchmark summary
naive_deep_error_counterexample.guarded_prototype: Routes depth >=64 and non-native/nonfinite values through the original dump; the saved test reports the 14 tested guarded edge results preserved.
naive_deep_error_counterexample.limit: Does not prove arbitrary call-stack equivalence or behavior on every Python version.

caveats: Fixtures use generated default-paper controller state and synthetic window/inventory clones; there is no production payload or financial history, and no enlarged-state reload correctness claim.
Mirror output is measured on buffered local temporary files without fsync; production archive population, CPU contention, and live callback scheduling were not reproduced.
The one-write path holds the entire encoded string and materially raises traced peak memory on the large fixture.
The KV guard showed roughly 10–12 percent improvement on tested large fixtures; no candidate was selected.
The 1100-level counterexample shows changed exception behavior for a deep synthetic object; it is not stated as financial recovery risk.
No financial-risk or validation-status conclusion is made.

separate_timing_context.startup_producer_correction: The four early startup timing rows are within-row connection measurements from an unidentified producer. WeatherWS inherits the same logger and instance-local session counter, so those rows cannot be assigned to BTC/speed-desk or grouped as unique producers by session number alone.

main_known_matching_local_work_event.limitation: Mirror is a contributor within that interval, not the whole delay; parent/nested work must not be added. This separately identified production event is not a synthetic benchmark result.
